name: Buffalo Hunter

features.name: Stampede Super Bonus
features.description: Five scatters unlock the top bonus.

review:
Buffalo Hunter is a 5x4 prairie slot where dreamcatcher mystery symbols all reveal the same symbol. Three or four scatters let you choose a bonus: Buffalo Horde turns premiums into buffalo, and Prairie Multipliers add up to x5 to each premium. Both give +2 spins for every upgrade.

Five scatters go straight to the Stampede Super Bonus. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 12,647x cap and a 32% hit rate, so wins come fairly often for the studio. It's a twist on the classic buffalo theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
